# CompliancePreflight

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Evaluates a layout snapshot against the PDF/UA-1 accessibility rules. Pure and deterministic.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`Evaluate`](#evaluate): Evaluates a layout snapshot and returns a per-element report.

### `Evaluate`

```csharp
ComplianceReport Evaluate(LayoutSnapshot snapshot)
ComplianceReport Evaluate(LayoutSnapshot snapshot, CompliancePreflightOptions options)
```

*static*

Evaluates a layout snapshot and returns a per-element report. The rules are checked unconditionally (independent of AccessibilityMode), so the report answers "is this document accessible, and if not, where?" for any document.
